Data Analyst - New Grad

Des Moines, IA, US · Full-time

Company Description

Example Corp is a regional insurer with two million members. Our analytics group of forty people supports actuarial, underwriting, and claims.

Job Description

Responsible for extracting, integrating, analyzing, and interpreting data from internal and external sources to answer business questions for the actuarial, underwriting, and claims teams. Builds and maintains reports, dashboards, and data models that the business relies on every week.

  • Translate questions from business partners into analyses and present the findings.
  • Write SQL and Python to assemble and validate data sets.
  • Maintain the team's Power BI dashboards and their documentation.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field completed by June 2027.
  • Coursework or internship experience with SQL and a statistics package.
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States.

Additional Information

Hybrid, three days a week in Des Moines. Example Corp is an equal opportunity employer.
